meta.note: Agent-ready task queue. Each task is self-contained: inputs, outputs, acceptance criteria. Workstreams: GROUND (literature), FORMALIZE (definitions), PROVE, EXTEND (experiments/data), CONNECT (bridge writing), INFRA. status: open | in_progress | done | blocked. Update status and append to 'log' when working a task.

tasks.title: Verify unverified citations
tasks.acceptance: Every 'unverified' entry is either 'checked' with a URL or flagged 'not-found' in annotation; rogerschain2026, feng2024 and the ICLR blogpost audit of wen2025 resolved.

tasks.title: Check from-memory entries in priority layers
tasks.acceptance: All entries cited as evidence by K30, K31, K33, K45, K47, K50, K54 are 'checked'.

tasks.title: Fill literature gaps
inputs: concepts.json nodes with fewer than 2 bibliography entries
tasks.acceptance: Every concept has >=2 entries, including at least one formal and one humanistic where applicable. Run tools/validate.py --coverage.

tasks.title: Unify notation across GM, outline v1 and spine
tasks.acceptance: Single table mapping every symbol (Omega, G, D, theta, delta, N_e, v, c, phi, r, lambda, L) to definition and first use; no clashes.

tasks.title: Define delta_latent and N_e operationally
tasks.acceptance: Estimators specified for text corpora and for model ensembles, with a style-invariance test; matches E-01 design.

tasks.title: Formalize sustained compression progress
tasks.acceptance: L(x;R) defined for computable compressors with explicit reader-state dynamics; shows finite L for fixed-prior readers on finite-depth texts.

tasks.title: Estimate the regime table
outputs: data/regimes.json with sourced estimates or ranges per parameter per regime
tasks.acceptance: Each cell has a numeric range or ordinal with a citation, or is marked unknown.

tasks.title: Finite-world proofs (GM Phase 1 + K10, K26)
tasks.acceptance: Proofs of GM T1, T2 (with corrected condition), T4.1-2, T5, C11, K10, K26 in finite Omega = Z_N x seasons.

tasks.title: Add poverty-of-stimulus evidence
tasks.acceptance: D5 has >=3 checked llm_evidence entries on both sides.

tasks.title: Migration-drift theorem for source mixtures (K31)
tasks.acceptance: Theorem: in a K-source Wright-Fisher mixture with generalized-JS divergence delta, effective migration m(delta) is monotone and equilibrium heterozygosity has stated form; collapse when delta->0 without mutation.

tasks.title: Rogers threshold with stateful Omega (K33)
tasks.acceptance: Closed-form or bounded v* as function of drift rate and verification cost; reduces to Rogers 1988 at stationarity.

tasks.title: Performative decomposition identifiability (K40)
tasks.acceptance: Conditions under which Delta F_learn and Delta F_perform are separately identifiable from observational panels.

tasks.title: Gaslighting-psychosis precision theorem (K54)
tasks.acceptance: I(Omega; belief) as function of self-precision ratio under adversarial testimony is unimodal with max at calibration.

tasks.title: Run E-01 and E-04 (cheapest decisive experiments)
tasks.acceptance: Reported with code, seeds, and pass/fail against stated predictions.

tasks.title: Bridge essay: literature as sustained compression progress
tasks.acceptance: Readable by a literary theorist; every formal claim has a humanistic citation and vice versa; states falsifiers.

tasks.title: Bridge essay: retrospective verification as method
tasks.acceptance: Defines the method, its validity conditions (when an LLM result bears on a humanistic claim), and audits D1-D21.

tasks.title: Bridge essay: the canon as a transmission network
tasks.acceptance: Hopkins, Beowulf, Donne and Firth worked as formal cases with data where available.

tasks.title: Keep validators green
tasks.acceptance: python3 tools/validate.py exits 0 after every change.

tasks.title: Reconcile with One Selection Law seams
outputs: Seam entries added to claims.json as K-ids or links
tasks.acceptance: All five seams mapped to spine claims with status.

tasks.title: Historical pedagogy sources
outputs: Checked entries on trivium/quadrivium, keju/baguwen, early Royal Society
tasks.acceptance: Each claim in spine L6 about pedagogy cites a checked historical source; Gu Yanwu quotation verified or removed.

tasks.title: Build the phenomena menu blind to the formalism
inputs: field surveys and textbooks via Semantic Scholar / arXiv
outputs: program/data/phenomena.json: at least 10 phenomena and 2 negative controls per field, added with provenance.blind = true
tasks.acceptance: The builder agent never sees spine.md, GM or claims.json; each entry has a bib key (added to bibliography.json and Librarian-checked) or a source hint; robust/replicated strength is supported by a checked review or meta-analysis; validate.py passes. Includes phenomena hostile to the program (e.g. poverty of the stimulus, content biases).

tasks.title: Assess rival formalisms on the same menu
outputs: One assessment per phenomenon per rival formalism
tasks.acceptance: Each rival is assessed by an agent instructed to argue for that rival, with the same verdict rules as the spine; the scoreboard reports the spine's score relative to each rival.

tasks.title: Re-assess seed verdicts and demonstrate emergence
outputs: Reviewed assessments with tiers; emergence demonstrations under program/proofs or program/experiments
tasks.acceptance: Every must_emerge item either has a derivation at V3 or above, or a toy-model run in which the behavior appears without being coded in (with a code audit showing that), or is reclassified. Premise audit: each derivation's premises are core axioms or verified claims. The P-030/P-031 pair comes from one mechanism with only the frame varied.
